attribution.title: Het Lieverdje (Spui) - reconstruction from photographs
attribution.author: Map Recall; sculpture by Carel Kneulman (1960); figure reconstructed from photographs by Ceescamel
attribution.modifications: Figure reconstructed (TRELLIS.2 multi-view) from Wikimedia Commons photographs: "2024 Lieverdje, Amsterdam (D).jpg" by Ceescamel (CC0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2024_Lieverdje,_Amsterdam_(D).jpg); "2024 Lieverdje, Amsterdam (E).jpg" by Ceescamel (CC0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2024_Lieverdje,_Amsterdam_(E).jpg); "2024 Lieverdje, Amsterdam (G).jpg" by Ceescamel (CC0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2024_Lieverdje,_Amsterdam_(G).jpg); "2024 Lieverdje, Amsterdam (F).jpg" by Ceescamel (CC0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2024_Lieverdje,_Amsterdam_(F).jpg). Decimated to about 6,000 triangles per figure in the kit's material, no photo colour; plinth, pier and setting are the original low-poly kit model. Provenance: scripts/sculptures/rebuild-sources/lieverdje.json.
